Hi Alyssa / Tom,

Great to connect on the call yesterday — thanks for the time. As discussed, we'd love to set up a concise executive demo to introduce Redwood's inference platform to your execs and share the ROI profile for your anticipated workload. The ask from our side: can your CIO or VP of Engineering join for the first 20–30 minutes for strategic alignment? We find that helps prioritize the follow-up pilot scope.

Proposed windows (PDT):
- Tue Jun 1 — 09:00–09:45
- Tue Jun 1 — 13:00–13:45
- Wed Jun 2 — 10:00–10:45

If none of those work, send two options that do. I've attached a short agenda (15–30 minute executive overview + 15 min Q&A) and our suggested pre-brief checklist.

Attaching: bridgebook-demo-agenda-20270528.pdf

Thanks — happy to tighten the agenda if your CIO prefers a narrow exec-level discussion (20 minutes).

Best,
